title: [epic] WebDAV block store backend
description:
## Why
WebDAV is supported by Nextcloud, Synology NAS, Hetzner Storage Box, and many other self-hosted and hosted storage services. A WebDAV backend lets operators store blocks on existing infrastructure without S3 compatibility or cloud vendor lock-in.

## Scope
- `[backend] type = "webdav"` config: `url`, optional `username`/`password` or bearer token
- `WebDavStore: IpfsStore` backed by `reqwest` (PUT/GET/DELETE over HTTP); object path = `<base_url>/<cid-base32>`
- Startup: verify base URL reachable (PROPFIND or OPTIONS)
- Integration test against a local WebDAV server (e.g. `nginx` with DAV module or `wsgidav`) via docker-compose
- Tested against: Nextcloud, Hetzner Storage Box, Synology WebDAV Server
- RUNBOOK section
